messages.subject: unmarked frame
parts:
Helo dear all, I am new at the R language and I am having some trouble with an unmerked script. I am working with distance sampling data. 

 The script is 

umf<- unmarkedFrameDS(y=as.matrix(yDat), siteCovs=covas,survey="line",dist.breaks=intervalos ,tlength=c(100,200,100),unitsIn="m")
 
and this is the error

 in unmarkedFrameDS(y = as.matrix(yDat), siteCovs = covas, survey = "line",  :   tlength should be a vector with length(tlength)==nrow(y)


regards
